item.title: Aria2 + AriaNG Configuration and Usage
item.description: Aria2 is a download tool on Linux. Here we introduce its installation and configuration under Windows. The official Aria2 does not have a GUI, so we use AriaNG to operate it directly via a web interface. AriaNg is a modern web frontend that makes aria2 easier to use. AriaNg is developed using pure HTML & javascript, so it does not require any compiler or runtime environment.
